title: dennstaedtia scabra
intro: Dennstaedtia scabra, commonly known as Rough Shore Fern, is a type of fern that belongs to the Dennstaedtiaceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Dennstaedtia scabra include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its ability to alleviate pain and improve overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential uses in treating various diseases.
